title: Cool Curios
description: A mod that adds some curios (I think that is the term)
body:
# REQUIRES CURIOS API
This is just a fun little mod to add to your modpack. (If it has Curios API)

Curios:
  1.   Snow Trinket (Allows you to walk on powdered snow)
  2.   Speed Trinket (Makes you faster)
  3.   Strength Trinket (Makes you stronger)
  4.   Lava Trinket (Makes you immune to all fire)
  5.   O2 Trinket (Gives you infinite O2, Good while swiming)

Also feel free to add this to any modpack you want!

I want to update this a lot, but might not have the time due to school work.
